levels.name: Beginner

levels.name: Intermediate

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Administrators and migration specialists. Configure, operate and migrate Windchill.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Architects and developers. Design enterprise solutions, integrations and upgrade-safe customizations.

roles.name: End User / Engineer

roles.name: Solution Architect
